design_principles: No single aggregate leaderboard score across semantically different tracks.
Predictions must be frozen before gold reveal.
Support/permission evidence may be reused as constraints but never promoted to necessity authority.
Holdout is pair-level and may not be used for method tuning.
External source versions are pinned and provenance is retained.
Runtime benchmark uncertainty is reported with pair-preserving confidence intervals, not point estimates alone.

tracks.title: Runtime necessity under paired agent environments
tracks.purpose: Measure whether tool-visible, proposition-specific evidence can reduce unnecessary action without collapsing required-action recall.
tracks.authority_rule: Tool success/availability alone is never proposition authority.

statistics.rationale: ACT and ABSTAIN variants from one pair are dependent and must be resampled together.

tracks.title: Residual violation across real partial-fix history
tracks.purpose: Verify that an intermediate incomplete fix can still justify ACT while a later final fix justifies ABSTAIN.

source.name: P3
source.license_status: source-specific; benchmark metadata reuse allowed by project access, original project licensing must be preserved

tracks.authority_rule: Oracle is bounded to the issue-derived CMD_BSL zero-branch proposition and may not claim global bug absence.

tracks.title: Evidence support versus necessity authority
tracks.purpose: Verify that mature action-support evidence can be reused without being promoted to residual necessity.
tracks.authority_rule: SafeAct support is constraint evidence only; MISSING/DEFER does not grant negative necessity authority.

aggregation.rationale: Tracks test distinct semantics and failure modes; one weighted score could hide a safety failure in another track.
